idea-plugin.name: DATAMIMIC
idea-plugin.description:
Work on DATAMIMIC projects in your JetBrains IDE, connected to your DATAMIMIC Enterprise Platform.

Requires a DATAMIMIC Enterprise Platform and an account on it. The plugin does not work without one; support for the open-source DATAMIMIC CE is planned.

  • Sign in with your platform account and browse your projects in the DATAMIMIC tool window.
  • Open a platform project as a normal local project. Files sync both ways, protected by the platform's edit locks; changes on both sides show a conflict banner.
  • Completion and checks from the platform's language server, with a status bar switch to turn it on or off for the project.
  • Generate data on the platform and preview the results.
  • Connect IDE agents to the project's MCP server.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0: first public version. Requires a DATAMIMIC Enterprise Platform.

  • Sign in, browse projects, and open a platform project as a synced local project.
  • Edit locks, conflict banners, and live updates from the platform.
  • Completion and checks from the platform's language server, with a status bar switch.
  • Data generation with log and preview; MCP access for IDE agents.
